slides.title: Bolt follows orders
slides.text: Bolt does exactly what the program says, in order, and never guesses what you meant. The order of your steps is everything.

slides.title: Plan in plain words
slides.text: Pro programmers write the plan in plain words before they touch a block. That plan is called pseudocode. A flowchart is the same plan drawn with boxes and diamonds.

slides.title: From plan to blocks
slides.text: Each plan line becomes one run of blocks you can test on its own. Splitting a big problem into parts like this is called decomposing.

slides.title: Compare routes
slides.text: When two routes both work, compare them: fewer steps, fewer turns, fewer chances to go wrong. Count, then pick.

words.means: a sequence of steps that solves a problem
a plan written in plain words, one line per part
a plan drawn with boxes for actions and diamonds for questions
split a big problem into smaller parts

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Robo Route at Sequences and finish 4 levels. When a level shows plan lines, put them in order first, then build one plan line at a time.
